content.short: Fabrica lets real estate assets live in your wallet and has completed over 1k on-chain operations.
content.description: Fabrica offers an evolving, pragmatic framework to represent real estate assets on a blockchain, provided as primitives to build new real estate applications and empower on-chain experimentation with property representations. The project remains rooted in respect for land rights and has experimented with NFTs to symbolize land rights since 2018, dedicating thousands of hours to refine a system that enables on-ramping of properties at scale.
content.meta: Fabrica provides pragmatic framework to represent real estate assets on blockchain. Discover Fabrica and other Real World Asset Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
